description: Students delve into advanced French language and culture through background readings, site visits, and multimedia exploration of topics including the French court, the medieval cathedral, visual art, immigration, and social protest. They read, discuss, and analyze texts from the Middle Ages to the 21st century, engaging with plays and films to discover Paris through diverse perspectives. Taught in French. Offered alternate years during January term. Apply through Smith Center for Global Engagement. Prerequisite: One French 250-level course (two recommended).
name: ID French Studies - Paris
notes: This is a study abroad course. You will find this course listed in Studio Abroad
title: Interdisciplinary French Studies in Paris
